ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 70% high-intensity white/cream pixels in the central lobes vs. 30% low-intensity black pixels along the margins and trailing edges.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central lobes contain large contiguous regions of white/cream pixels. Low-intensity black pixels form a continuous perimeter along the trailing edge and lateral margins. Distinct dark focal spots are visible in the upper mid-section of the left lobe and lower mid-section of the right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped depression with a calculated internal angle of approximately 42 degrees.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge; notable high-amplitude notches (valleys) are located approximately halfway between the median notch and distal tips on both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Concave sweep from the median notch transitioning to convex curves toward the distal tips; tips are oriented upward and slightly outward.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-relief, high-intensity tan/white pixel clusters (barnacle colonies) are densely packed on both the left and right distal tips. Isolated dark circular pixel clusters are present on the white ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Series of at least five parallel, vertical, low-intensity linear streaks (rake marks) on the right lobe, with additional scattered diagonal linear disruptions on the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Multiple vertical rake marks on the right ventral surface; extensive barnacle encrustation on the lateral tips; large dark puncture-like spot on the upper left lobe.
other_distinctive_markers: Significant yellow-tan chromatic staining distributed centrally within the high-intensity white regions of both fluke lobes.
